A '''Geldan sun-apple''' was a type [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Gelda system/Legends|Gelda system]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /><ref name="Maelstrom" /> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], offered to add Geldan sun-apple flavored syurp to any of the [[fizzyglug]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverages]] that it sold at no additional charge.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> At some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="">The [[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']] adventure takes place while the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] is active in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' establishes that the alliance was created in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. The alliance was transitioned in to the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] during the events of the ''[[The Truce at Bakura]]'' which the ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Kuari Princess]]'' had a barrel of sun-apples.<ref name="Maelstrom" />

==Behind the scenes==
Geldan sun-apples first appeared in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] adventure [[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']], written by [[Ray Winninger]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1989]]. In the adventure, the barrel of sun-apples were part of an optional comic relief event where the merchant would suddenly pop out of the barrel and offer to purchase each piece of the players' equipment.<ref name="Maelstrom" />
